PPCServiceAdjustWOActualBody.description:
AdjustWOActual sets qty_actual (audit axis) away from the immutable
qty_bobbin baseline, marking the row ADJUSTED and logging the correction.

PPCServiceApproveMTSDemandBody.description: ApproveMTSDemand is the Marketing approval for an MTS demand request.

PPCServiceApproveWOBody.description:
ApproveWO records a sequential approval. approval_side="PC" moves
SUBMITTED -> PC_APPROVED; "PM" moves PC_APPROVED -> APPROVED (PM only after
PC). Snapshots (spec/packing) are taken at approval.

pcValues.description: PC values (default to the PPC values when omitted).

PPCServiceApproveWOParameterBody.description:
ApproveWOParameter is the PC step: review + fill/confirm the PC parameter
values. Moves SUBMITTED -> PC_APPROVED (sequential; PM approves after).

PPCServiceConfirmDemandBody.description: ConfirmDemand moves a demand from PENDING_CONFIRMATION to CONFIRMED.

machineId.description: Optional machine override (defaults to the source WO's machine).

PPCServiceCreateWOReferenceBody.description:
CreateWOReference creates a new WO from a prior one. TEMPLATE = duplicate
(soft copy of PPC params, new lot, no binding); CONTINUATION = hard link
inheriting the source demand + params (remaining qty tops up the same demand).

PPCServiceMapDemandProductBody.description:
MapDemandProduct maps a product onto a demand with no product yet mapped
(e.g. an Orion-pulled demand). Rejected if the demand is already mapped.

replace.title: also persist (replace stored lines) with the suggestions

PPCServicePopulateWORmFromRouteBody.description:
PopulateWORmFromRoute auto-materializes RM allocation lines for a WO from its
product route (cost_route_rm), one line per route RM component with a
ratio-derived qty suggestion. PPC then reviews/adjusts and persists via
SaveWORmAllocations. When replace=true the suggested lines also replace the
stored allocations in the same call.

splits.description: Split children for SPLIT (sum of qty must be <= source remaining).

newDeadline.description:
New deadline for CARRY_AS_IS / PARTIAL_CARRY. Defaults to the source
deadline when omitted.

carryQty.description:
Carried qty for PARTIAL_CARRY. Must not exceed the candidate's
qty_uncovered.

lotNo.description:
Lot number for the continuation. Blank means auto-generate via the
lot-provisioning path, exactly like creating a WO from scratch. An explicit
value must already exist in lot_master (validateLot).

Bound matches work_order.wo_lot_no VARCHAR(30), as every other lot_no field
in this file does. At 50 a 31..50-char lot cleared validation and then failed
at INSERT as a raw driver error, which reaches the planner as a 500 instead
of a field-level complaint. Generated lots are 10 chars, so nothing real is
excluded by the tighter bound.

carryQty.description:
Qty to carry. When unset or zero, the whole remaining qty is carried.

The pattern admits the empty string: full-remainder is the ordinary case and
the BFF sends "" for it. The previous rule had no empty alternative, so the
documented unset path was unreachable through the RPC — every carry that
left the qty blank was refused at the validation boundary before the handler
(which already checks `req.CarryQty != ""`) could apply the default.

PPCServiceProcessWorkOrderCarryForwardBo.description:
One WO carry action. The action vocabulary is narrower than demand carry
because WOs are production instructions, not quantity balances: a carried WO
is always a continuation, and rejecting it to close-reroute is a manual
planner decision on the source WO's own detail page.

PPCServiceRejectWOBody.description: RejectWO sends a submitted WO back to PPC with a reason (manual + audited).

PPCServiceSaveWOExecutionBody.description: SaveWOExecution upserts an actual parameter value for a date+shift+param.

PPCServiceSaveWOParametersBody.description:
SaveWOParameters upserts the planned PPC parameter values on a DRAFT WO
(materialized param rows). Does not change status.

PPCServiceSaveWORmAllocationsBody.description: SaveWORmAllocations replaces the RM allocation lines for a WO.

PPCServiceSetStagingProductBody.description:
SetStagingProduct persists a planner's manual product pick onto a staging
row (match_status becomes MANUAL), so the next ETL resolution pass leaves the
row alone and the pick survives beyond the browser session.

PPCServiceStartChangeoverBody.description: StartChangeover transitions a PLANNED event to IN_PROGRESS.

PPCServiceSubmitWOBody.description:
SubmitWO moves a DRAFT WO to SUBMITTED, optionally setting/confirming the PPC
parameter values in the same call.

PPCServiceUpdateChangeoverActualBody.description: UpdateChangeoverActual records actual duration/waste and completes the event.

PPCServiceUpdateCustomerBody.description:
Update edits a customer. The code is immutable — it is the key the sync
upserts on.

spec.description:
spec, when set, replaces the yarn/packing specification wholesale. Omitting
it leaves the stored spec untouched, so a planner correcting only the
standard weights does not have to round-trip seventeen fields.

Editing a sync-sourced lot is deliberately allowed: the sync merges with
COALESCE, so a PPC correction survives the next run.

PPCServiceUpdateMachineBody.description: Update edits PPC-only fields; these are preserved across machine syncs.

changeReason.description: Reason recorded in the plan-change log (required for material edits).

plannedStartDate.description:
Setting either timeline field marks the item MANUAL; omitting both leaves
the existing duration source untouched.

PPCServiceUpdatePlanItemBody.description: Update edits mutable fields; changes are recorded in production_plan_log.

revisionReason.description: Required when revising an approved/running WO (shown on the WO face).

protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

v1ActiveFilter.description:
ActiveFilter is the standard active/inactive list filter for PPC masters.

 - ACTIVE_FILTER_UNSPECIFIED: No filter (show all).
 - ACTIVE_FILTER_ACTIVE: Only active rows.
 - ACTIVE_FILTER_INACTIVE: Only inactive rows.

v1AreaCode.description:
AreaCode identifies the production area a machine / work order belongs to.

 - AREA_CODE_UNSPECIFIED: Default / no-filter.
 - AREA_CODE_TXT: Texturizing (DTY/ACY/ATY).
 - AREA_CODE_SPG: Spinning (POY).
 - AREA_CODE_TWT: Twisting.

v1AreaShiftLog.description: AreaShiftLog is the department-level shift entry (OT hours, notes).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created (ISO 8601).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated (ISO 8601).

updatedBy.description: User who last updated the record.

v1BalanceForSaleRow.description: BalanceForSaleRow is per-commodity-watch product AX balance.

validationErrors.description: List of validation errors if any.

isSuccess.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

v1BaseResponse.description: BaseResponse is the standard response wrapper for all API responses.

v1CarryAction.description:
CarryAction is the per-demand decision in the start-new-month workflow.

 - CARRY_ACTION_UNSPECIFIED: Default / none.
 - CARRY_ACTION_CARRY_AS_IS: New demand qty = remaining.
 - CARRY_ACTION_SPLIT: Split into N new demands (sum <= remaining).
 - CARRY_ACTION_DEFER: Push to next month.
 - CARRY_ACTION_PARTIAL_CARRY: Carry part, cancel the rest.
 - CARRY_ACTION_CANCEL: Close the demand.

v1CarryForwardSplit.description: ProcessCarryForward executes a per-demand carry-forward action at month start.

v1ChangeoverComponent.description: ChangeoverComponent is one applied changeover component (BASE or C1-C7).

v1ChangeoverComponentInput.description:
ChangeoverComponentInput is a PPC override line for a create request
(add/remove/adjust auto-detected components).

v1ChangeoverEvent.description: ChangeoverEvent is a changeover between two WOs on a machine.

v1CommonLot.description:
CommonLot is a consolidated ERP lot combining leftover bobbins from several
original lots (potentially different shades) under a new ERP identity.

v1CommonLotComponent.description: CommonLotComponent is one original lot folded into a common lot.

v1CommonLotComponentInput.description:
CommonLotComponentInput is one component line supplied when creating a common
lot.

v1CreateChangeoverEventRequest.description:
CreateChangeoverEvent persists a planned changeover event. When components
are omitted they are auto-detected from the WO spec diff; machine_id = 0
resolves to the destination WO's machine.

v1CreateCustomerRequest.description: Create hand-adds a customer; the row is marked MANUAL.

cpmProductSysId.description:
Omitted for an MTS/SAMPLE demand raised before its finance master exists.
The demand is then saved as PENDING_PRODUCT_LINK and linked later via
MapDemandProduct; the domain refuses a missing product in any other case.

month.description: Derived from deadline unless month_override is set (carry-forward only).

monthOverride.description: Allows month to diverge from the deadline (carry-forward remainder).

v1CreateMachineRequest.description: Create is used for the rare hand-added machine; normal flow is SyncMachines.

demandId.description: Exactly one of demand_id / parent_item_id is expected (validated in app).

month.description: Derived from deadline unless month_override is set (carry-forward only).

plannedStartDate.description:
Optional planner-supplied timeline. Setting either marks the item MANUAL;
omitting both leaves the duration system-derived from qty/capacity.

monthOverride.description: Allows month to diverge from the deadline (carry-forward remainder).

childData.description:
Deprecated: use `children` instead. Kept populated with `children[0]` for
one release so clients built against the single-child cascade keep working
during a rolling deploy.

children.description:
Every cascade-generated upstream INTERMEDIATE plan item, ordered by
increasing route level (closest to the FG first). Empty when the product
has no released route, in which case `cascade_warning` explains why.

cascadeWarning.description:
Explains a save that legitimately succeeded but generated no upstream
items — most often a product whose route is still DRAFT rather than
COMPLETE/LOCKED. Empty when the cascade ran normally. A dedicated field,
not a suffix on base.message, so the client never has to parse prose.

lotNo.description:
Blank means "mint one": the server generates a transcribable
{AREA}{SEQ:04d}-{YY} lot, registers it in lot_master and persists the work
order in the same transaction. A supplied lot must already exist in
lot_master and is rejected otherwise — never silently created. No min_len
here on purpose; requiring one made the generator unreachable through the
RPC. Bound matches work_order.wo_lot_no VARCHAR(30).

additionalPlanItemIds.description:
Merge: extra plan items covered by this WO alongside the anchor
(plan_item_id). Always an explicit planner choice, never automatic. Each
must satisfy the merge predicate against the anchor (see
ListMergeCandidates) — the server re-validates and rejects otherwise.

qtyContributions.description:
Per-item qty contribution, decimal-as-string, positionally aligned with
additional_plan_item_ids. Omit (or leave empty) to default to that plan
item's qty_target. The WO qty_target becomes the sum of the anchor's
contribution and these.

v1Customer.description: Customer is the PPC customer master row.

v1CustomerImportError.description: CustomerImportError reports one failed import row.

v1DailyPerformanceKpi.description: DailyPerformanceKpi is one KPI card value (today + MTD).

shadeCode.description: Shade (colour) carried from the Orion staging row at pull time.

productLinkReason.description:
Why the product is not linked yet, when status is PENDING_PRODUCT_LINK:
AUTO_MATCH_FAILED | AMBIGUOUS | NO_MASTER_YET. Empty once linked.

orionItemCode.description:
Orion item code of the staging row this demand was pulled from, joined
from sales_order_staging via sos_ref. Empty for a manually-created demand.
It is the only human-readable identity an unlinked demand has, so the UI
can name the row instead of rendering a placeholder dash.

customerCode.description:
Customer code/name resolved from the PPC customer master via customer_id.
Denormalized for UI the same way product_code/product_name are: the demand
list and detail must name the customer without a second round trip, and an
id alone is never shown to a planner. Empty when customer_id is unset or
the master row has since gone.

v1Demand.description: Demand is a Layer-1 production commitment.

v1DemandSource.description:
DemandSource records how a demand entered the system.

 - DEMAND_SOURCE_UNSPECIFIED: Default / no-filter.
 - DEMAND_SOURCE_ORION_PULL: Pulled from Orion SO staging (LOV).
 - DEMAND_SOURCE_MANUAL: Manually entered by PPC.
 - DEMAND_SOURCE_MTS_APPROVED: Created after Marketing approves an MTS request.
 - DEMAND_SOURCE_CARRY_FORWARD: Created by the start-new-month carry-forward workflow.

v1DemandStatus.description:
DemandStatus is the lifecycle state of a demand.

 - DEMAND_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: Default / no-filter.
 - DEMAND_STATUS_PENDING_CONFIRMATION: Awaiting PPC confirm.
 - DEMAND_STATUS_CONFIRMED: Confirmed by PPC.
 - DEMAND_STATUS_IN_PRODUCTION: At least one WO created.
 - DEMAND_STATUS_PARTIAL: Partially fulfilled.
 - DEMAND_STATUS_FULFILLED: Fully fulfilled.
 - DEMAND_STATUS_CANCELLED: Cancelled.
 - DEMAND_STATUS_CARRIED_OVER: Carried to a new month via carry-forward.
 - DEMAND_STATUS_DEFERRED: Pushed to next month at customer request.
 - DEMAND_STATUS_SPLIT: Split into N new demands.
 - DEMAND_STATUS_PENDING_PRODUCT_LINK: Saved without a product; awaiting a manual link.

v1DemandSubType.description:
DemandSubType further classifies a demand within its type.

 - DEMAND_SUB_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Default / none.
 - DEMAND_SUB_TYPE_CF_EXPORT: Carry-forward export from a prior month.
 - DEMAND_SUB_TYPE_NEW_EXPORT: New export booking this month.
 - DEMAND_SUB_TYPE_LOCAL: Local order.
 - DEMAND_SUB_TYPE_INTERNAL: Internal (MTS).

v1DemandType.description:
DemandType is the top-level classification of a production demand.

 - DEMAND_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Default / no-filter.
 - DEMAND_TYPE_CONTRACT: Customer contract commitment.
 - DEMAND_TYPE_MTS: Make-to-stock (no specific order).
 - DEMAND_TYPE_SAMPLE: Sample / development order.

v1DetectChangeoverRequest.description:
DetectChangeover previews the active components (BASE, C1-C7), estimated
duration/waste and group for a hypothetical changeover between two WOs.
It does NOT persist anything.

v1DowntimeEntry.description: DowntimeEntry is one downtime line in a shift submission.

v1DowntimeReasonMaster.description: DowntimeReasonMaster is a per-area configurable downtime/idle reason code.

v1EfficiencySnapshot.description: EfficiencySnapshot is a computed efficiency roll-up (dashboard basis).

v1ExportDailyPerformanceResponse.description: ExportDailyPerformanceResponse carries the generated Excel workbook.

woId.title: 0 if not yet scheduled to a WO

isChangeover.description: True when this bar represents a changeover slot (red-dashed).

v1GanttBar.description: GanttBar is one scheduled bar on the plan timeline (Y=machine, X=days).

v1GradeReq.description:
GradeReq expresses the grade requirement attached to a demand.

 - GRADE_REQ_UNSPECIFIED: Default / no-filter.
 - GRADE_REQ_AX_ONLY: Customer accepts grade AX only.
 - GRADE_REQ_AX_AM_CLAUSE: AX plus a bounded AM fraction (ax_min/am_max).
 - GRADE_REQ_NONE: No specific grade requirement.

sosIds.description: Ids actually returned, capped at the PullFromOrion batch limit (200).

totalMatched.description:
How many rows match the filter in total, before the cap. Greater than
len(sos_ids) means the caller received a truncated set and must say so.

limit.description: The cap applied, so a caller never has to hard-code it.

sourceKey.title: MMSMERGE.MERGE_CODE verbatim; empty for PPC lots

syncedAt.title: ISO-8601; last successful sync, empty for PPC lots

v1LotMaster.description:
LotMaster holds per-lot standard bobbin weights (full / unfull) used by the
TXT quantity calculation. Lot key = item_code + shade_code.

yarnType.title: YARN_TYPE; overlaps prod_type but is not identical

denier.title: MERGE_DENIER; VARCHAR2 in the source, kept as text

shadeColor.title: SHADE_COLOR, falling back to MERGE_COLOR / YARN_COLOR

sourceBobWeight.description:
decimal-as-string; MERGE_BOB verbatim, provisionally kg of yarn per bobbin.
UNCONFIRMED — it seeds std_weight_full on first import only.

sourceStatus.description:
16 is left free: every other message in this file reserves it for
common.v1.AuditInfo, and keeping the slot clear avoids a surprise if LotSpec
is ever promoted to a row of its own.

MERGE_STATUS verbatim

v1LotSpec.description:
LotSpec is the yarn and packing specification a lot carries, imported from
the legacy Oracle lot master ASPAK.MMSMERGE. Every field is optional: a
PPC-minted lot has none of it, and even an imported row leaves most empty.

Provenance (source / source_key / synced_at) lives on LotMaster, not here,
mirroring both the Customer message and the lot domain aggregate, where
source is an entity field and Spec carries no provenance.

v1Machine.description:
Machine is the PPC machine master. Rows originate from finance mst_machine +
Oracle TXTMACH via the sync worker; PPC-only fields are locally editable.

v1MachineGroup.description: MachineGroup groups machines within a production area.

v1McEffCell.description: McEffCell is one machine-shift efficiency heatmap cell.

v1MorningReviewIssue.description: MorningReviewIssue is an open issue needing action.

v1MorningReviewMachineRow.description: MorningReviewMachineRow is one machine's actual-vs-plan line.

v1MorningReviewPriority.description: MorningReviewPriority is a WO that must run today.

refId.title: scoped id per level (0 for SYSTEM)

v1OverrunThresholdConfig.description:
OverrunThresholdConfig is a 5-level over-production threshold. Resolution is
most-specific-wins: WO -> PRODUCT -> PRODUCT_TYPE -> MACHINE_GROUP -> SYSTEM.

totalItems.description: Total number of items across all pages.

v1PaginationResponse.description: PaginationResponse contains pagination metadata for list responses.

v1ParamResolutionSource.description:
ParamResolutionSource is which layer of the WO parameter chain a resolved
value came from (v1.2): WO-ref -> product+machine -> product -> default.

 - PARAM_RESOLUTION_SOURCE_UNSPECIFIED: No value resolved.
 - PARAM_RESOLUTION_SOURCE_WO_REF: From referenced / last-running WO (layer 1).
 - PARAM_RESOLUTION_SOURCE_PRODUCT_MACHINE: From product_machine_parameter (layer 2).
 - PARAM_RESOLUTION_SOURCE_PRODUCT: From cost_product_parameter (layer 3).
 - PARAM_RESOLUTION_SOURCE_DEFAULT: From mst_parameter.default_value (layer 4).

v1PlanCarryAction.description:
PlanCarryAction is the per-plan-item decision in the start-new-month
workflow. Deliberately NARROWER than CarryAction rather than a reuse of it:
the plan-item lifecycle (DRAFT/CONFIRMED/IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED/CLOSED) has no
DEFERRED state, so CARRY_ACTION_DEFER has nothing to map onto, and SPLIT would
need per-child machine groups and timelines that a demand split never carries.
Stretching CarryAction to cover plan items would make two of its five values
silently unimplementable.

 - PLAN_CARRY_ACTION_UNSPECIFIED: Default / none.
 - PLAN_CARRY_ACTION_CARRY_AS_IS: New plan item for the whole unplanned qty.
 - PLAN_CARRY_ACTION_PARTIAL_CARRY: Carry part; the rest is not carried.
 - PLAN_CARRY_ACTION_CANCEL: Close the plan item without carrying it.

qtyUncovered.description:
Qty on this item not yet committed to any work order:
qty_target - SUM(wo_plan_item_link.qty_contribution). This is what
CARRY_AS_IS carries, so a plan item already half-covered by a work order
does not get carried twice.

qtyCovered.description: Qty already covered by work orders, for context alongside qty_uncovered.

workOrderCount.description:
How many work orders reference this plan item. Non-zero means the work is
already in flight and the work-order carry scope may also apply to it.

alreadyCarried.description:
True when a plan item in the target month already names this one as its
carry source — a second run shows it as done rather than duplicating it.

demandLabel.description:
Human label of the demand this item serves, for traceability. Empty for a
cascade INTERMEDIATE item, which serves a parent item rather than a demand.

v1PlanCarryCandidate.description:
PlanCarryCandidate is one plan item eligible to be carried into a new month,
decorated with everything the planner needs to decide without seeing an id.

plannedStartDate.title: ISO-8601 date, empty when not scheduled

shadeCode.description:
Shade (colour) of the route product at this level. Natural at upstream
levels, which is what makes those items mergeable into one work order.

carryFromItemId.description:
Source plan item this one was carried forward from, 0 when it was not.
A new row per carry (never a month reassignment) is what keeps the source
month's plan an accurate record of what was committed there.

carryAction.description: The action that produced this item, when it came from a carry-forward.

v1PlanItem.description: PlanItem is one Layer-2 planning row.

v1PlanItemStatus.description:
PlanItemStatus is the lifecycle state of a plan item.

 - PLAN_ITEM_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: Default / no-filter.
 - PLAN_ITEM_STATUS_DRAFT: Newly created, not yet active.
 - PLAN_ITEM_STATUS_ACTIVE: Part of the living monthly plan.
 - PLAN_ITEM_STATUS_IN_PRODUCTION: At least one WO created from this item.
 - PLAN_ITEM_STATUS_COMPLETED: Fulfilled.
 - PLAN_ITEM_STATUS_CANCELLED: Cancelled.

v1PlanItemType.description:
PlanItemType classifies a production plan item.

 - PLAN_ITEM_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Default / no-filter.
 - PLAN_ITEM_TYPE_FG_DELIVERY: Finished-good delivery item (from a demand).
 - PLAN_ITEM_TYPE_INTERMEDIATE: Intermediate item (cascaded from a parent FG).
 - PLAN_ITEM_TYPE_MTS: Make-to-stock item.

code.title: equals the enum string value (e.g. AX_ONLY)

v1PpcLookup.description:
PpcLookup is a lightweight, PPC-owned display-metadata row. It supplies the
frontend with admin-configurable dropdown labels/order/active-state WITHOUT
making business enums dynamic. Backend business logic keeps validating against
Go enum constants; a code here MUST equal the enum string value it labels.

v1PpcShift.description:
PpcShift is the genuine shift master (per-row attributes). end_time may be
earlier than start_time to model a shift crossing midnight. Times are HH:MM.

data.description:
The plan item created in the target month. Absent for CANCEL, which
creates nothing.

v1ProdCategory.description:
ProdCategory classifies a WO for Including/Excluding efficiency slicing.

 - PROD_CATEGORY_UNSPECIFIED: Default (treated as NORMAL).
 - PROD_CATEGORY_NORMAL: Normal production (counted in Excluding headline).
 - PROD_CATEGORY_B_TO_B: Back-to-back (excluded from headline eff).
 - PROD_CATEGORY_APQ: APQ (excluded).
 - PROD_CATEGORY_TRIAL: Trial (excluded).
 - PROD_CATEGORY_SMALL_LOT: Small lot (excluded).

v1ProductMachineCapacity.description:
ProductMachineCapacity is the per-product per-machine capacity profile.
v1.2: planning-math only (no-of-machine-needed). Setup values that vary per
machine (speed / positions / draw-ratio) moved to ProductMachineParameter.

v1ProductMachineParameter.description:
ProductMachineParameter is the per-PRODUCT+MACHINE parameter value layer
(v1.2, Opt A). cost_product_parameter is per-product only; values that vary
per machine (speed, positions, draw-ratio) live here, referencing the same
mst_parameter definition (one definition, two grains). WO resolution chain:
WO-ref -> this layer -> cost_product_parameter -> mst_parameter.default.

denier.title: decimal-as-string; may be empty (Gap G-005 stopgap)

v1ProductPPCConfig.description:
ProductPPCConfig extends a finance CPM product with PPC planning attributes.
denier is the R4 stopgap override for theoretical efficiency (Gap G-005:
CPM has no denier field).

subType.title: classification applied to all pulled demands

v1PullFromOrionRequest.description: PullFromOrion creates demands from selected SO staging rows (LOV pattern).

v1QtyAxisSource.description:
QtyAxisSource records how wo_production_actual.qty_actual was derived on the
audit axis (v1.2 two-axis model). BOBBIN = default from ETL bobbin scan;
ADJUSTED = operator-corrected (delta vs qty_bobbin is the audit signal).

 - QTY_AXIS_SOURCE_UNSPECIFIED: Default / none.
 - QTY_AXIS_SOURCE_BOBBIN: From immutable ETL bobbin baseline.
 - QTY_AXIS_SOURCE_ADJUSTED: Operator-adjusted (owns the number).

v1QtySource.description:
QtySource records how wo_production_actual.calculated_qty_kg was derived.
The suggest priority chain (spec §6) resolves to one of these values;
MANUAL_OVERRIDE always wins and is preserved by ETL.

 - QTY_SOURCE_UNSPECIFIED: Default / none.
 - QTY_SOURCE_MANUAL_OVERRIDE: Operator override (never overwritten by ETL).
 - QTY_SOURCE_PACKING_DONE: P1: from wo_grade_actual (packing done).
 - QTY_SOURCE_QC_RELEASED: P2: TXT normal bobs QC released.
 - QTY_SOURCE_SPG_TRANSFERRED: P3: SPG transferred bobs (Phase 2).
 - QTY_SOURCE_TXT_TRANSFERRED: P4: TXT transferred bobbins.
 - QTY_SOURCE_DOFF_ESTIMATE: P5: SPG doff estimate (Phase 2).
 - QTY_SOURCE_NO_DATA: No data available.

v1RMSource.description:
RMSource is the raw-material sourcing mode.

 - RM_SOURCE_UNSPECIFIED: Default / none.
 - RM_SOURCE_STORE: From store stock.
 - RM_SOURCE_CAPTIVE: Captive (self-produced) RM.
 - RM_SOURCE_MIXED: Mixed store + captive.

v1RecalcEfficiencyRequest.description: RecalcEfficiency triggers an efficiency snapshot recompute for a scope/date.

refWoId.description: Optional reference WO to seed the top layer (duplicate/continuation).

displayGroup.description: Filter to a display_group (e.g. "Machine"). Empty = all WO groups.

v1ResolveWOParametersRequest.description:
ResolveWOParameters previews the resolved parameter set for a product on a
machine (optionally seeded by a reference WO), before materializing the WO.

v1ResolvedParam.description:
ResolvedParam is one param resolved through the WO parameter chain:
WO-ref -> product_machine_parameter -> cost_product_parameter -> default.

pulledToDemandId.title: 0 = available in LOV; else already pulled

cpmProductSysId.description:
Finance product resolution for (item_code, shade_code). ppc_db and
finance_db are separate databases, so this is resolved over gRPC and
cached on the staging row rather than joined.

0 = unresolved

cpmProductCode.title: decorated from finance, empty when unresolved

cpmProductName.title: decorated from finance, empty when unresolved

matchCount.description:
How many finance products matched at resolution time. Lets the UI say why
a row is unresolved ("3 products matched") instead of only that it is.

v1SalesOrderStaging.description:
SalesOrderStaging is the ETL inbox row from Oracle MGT_SO_PENDING_WEB.
Full-replaced each sync; pulled_to_demand_id is preserved across replaces.

v1ShiftLogNote.description:
ShiftLogNote is a log-book note per machine per shift (v1.2), replacing
machine_shift_log.activity_note. Two types: INSTRUKSI (handover) / ACTIVITY.

v1ShiftLogNoteType.description:
ShiftLogNoteType is the log-book note type (legacy PTMAL_ INSTRUKSI/ACTIVITY).

 - SHIFT_LOG_NOTE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Default / no-filter.
 - SHIFT_LOG_NOTE_TYPE_INSTRUKSI: Shift handover instruction.
 - SHIFT_LOG_NOTE_TYPE_ACTIVITY: Activity log entry.

v1SubmitAreaShiftLogRequest.description: SubmitAreaShiftLog records area-level shift data (OT hours, notes).

runningMinutes.description:
v1.2: running_minutes is derived from downtime server-side; if provided it
is treated as a hint/override only.

status.description: FINAL triggers efficiency recompute; DRAFT saves without recompute.

v1SubmitShiftEntryRequest.description:
SubmitShiftEntry submits a machine shift log plus its downtime/waste lines
in one call (the two-part shift entry form).

v1SyncCustomersRequest.description: SyncCustomers triggers an on-demand read-only upsert from Oracle OM_CUSTOMER.

sourceUsed.description: False when Oracle was unconfigured (no-op run).

v1SyncLotsRequest.description:
SyncLots triggers an on-demand read-only import from the legacy Oracle lot
master ASPAK.MMSMERGE. The merge preserves PPC-local corrections.

oracleUsed.description: False when Oracle was unconfigured (no-op run).

v1SyncMachinesRequest.description: SyncMachines triggers an on-demand upsert from finance + Oracle sources.

v1ThresholdLevel.description:
ThresholdLevel is the scope of an over-production threshold config.

 - THRESHOLD_LEVEL_UNSPECIFIED: Default / no-filter.
 - THRESHOLD_LEVEL_SYSTEM: Global default.
 - THRESHOLD_LEVEL_MACHINE_GROUP: Per machine group.
 - THRESHOLD_LEVEL_PRODUCT_TYPE: Per product type.
 - THRESHOLD_LEVEL_PRODUCT: Per product.
 - THRESHOLD_LEVEL_WO: Per work order.

v1ThresholdUnit.description:
ThresholdUnit is the unit an over-production threshold is expressed in.

 - THRESHOLD_UNIT_UNSPECIFIED: Default / none.
 - THRESHOLD_UNIT_PCT: Percentage over target.
 - THRESHOLD_UNIT_DOFF: Absolute doff (kg) over target.

field.description: The field name that failed validation.

v1ValidationError.description: ValidationError represents a single field validation error.

v1WOExecution.description:
WOExecution is an actual machine parameter recorded per date+shift+param
(1:N). Also carries actual-only params not part of the plan (e.g. ACY
Heater, D/R, Steps Process). Typed by the referenced param's data_type.

v1WOGradeActual.description:
WOGradeActual is one grade line of packing-done actuals for a work order,
sourced from Oracle MGTDAT.PPC_GRADE_ACTUAL and matched by original lot.
Grade hierarchy: AX/AE/A9/A/AM/APQ/B/BB/C/JLT.

v1WOParamValueInput.description:
WOParamValueInput is one typed parameter value in a submit/approve payload.
value_flag is a real bool — callers set has_value_flag to opt in for BOOLEAN
params (cannot distinguish "unset" from FALSE otherwise).

valuePpcNum.description:
PPC proposed value (typed by data_type).

decimal-as-string

valuePcNum.description:
PC confirmed value (filled at PC approval; defaults to the PPC value).

decimal-as-string

isDual.title: true only for the 8 dual PPC/PC params

v1WOParameter.description:
WOParameter is one planned machine parameter for a WO (1:N, per param).
3-level pattern: PPC proposed value -> PC confirmed value -> actual
(WOExecution). is_dual is true only for the 8 dual params (config, not a
master flag). Typed by the referenced mst_parameter.data_type.

productCode.description: Denormalized plan-item projection for the WO detail pane.

isAnchor.title: true for the plan item the planner started from

v1WOPlanItemLink.description:
WOPlanItemLink is one plan item covered by a work order (wo_plan_item_link).
Merging several plan items — same product, same machine group, compatible
shade, deadlines within a window — into ONE work order is an explicit
planner action; this is the row that records it, and its qty contribution.

qtyBobbin.description:
Two-axis audit (v1.2) — replaces legacy _ORGL.

decimal-as-string, immutable ETL baseline

qtyDoffedKg.description:
SPG dual basis: doffed = efficiency, transferred = fulfillment.

decimal-as-string

breaksShift1.description: Operator KPI shift inputs (legacy YARNBREAK_1/2/3, doff, CO failure).

v1WOProductionActual.description:
WOProductionActual is the 1:N per date+shift production actual (two-axis
model, v1.2). Audit axis: qty_bobbin (immutable ETL baseline) + qty_actual
(editable, default = qty_bobbin) + qty_source (BOBBIN/ADJUSTED). SPG dual
basis: qty_doffed_kg (efficiency) vs qty_transferred_kg (fulfillment).
Efficiency is ALWAYS derived from qty_actual. Including/Excluding is derived
from the WO's prod_category — not stored here.

v1WORefType.description:
WORefType is how a WO references a prior WO (v1.2 WO Reference).

 - WO_REF_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: No reference.
 - WO_REF_TYPE_TEMPLATE: Duplicate: soft copy of PPC params, new lot, no binding.
 - WO_REF_TYPE_CONTINUATION: Continuation: hard link inheriting demand + params.

rmCode.description:
Presentation-only decoration resolved from the product's released route
(finance CostMasterRouteRm). crm_rm_id stays the wire identity; these exist
so no consumer ever has to render that raw id to a user. Empty when the
route is unavailable or the edge is no longer part of it.

item / group / product code of the RM edge

rmName.title: display name of the RM edge

routeRmRatio.title: decimal-as-string, ratio the qty suggestion came from

v1WORmAllocation.description:
WORmAllocation is one RM component from the route (cost_route_rm), N per WO
(replaces the legacy POY/chips 1/2/3 fixed slots). rm_type=PRODUCT forms
automatic lot genealogy between products.

v1WORmAllocationInput.description: WORmAllocationInput is one RM allocation line in a save payload.

v1WOStatus.description:
WOStatus is the work-order lifecycle state.

 - WO_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: Default / no-filter.
 - WO_STATUS_DRAFT: Being drafted by PPC.
 - WO_STATUS_SUBMITTED: Submitted for sequential PC->PM approval.
 - WO_STATUS_APPROVED: Both PC and PM approved (PM after PC).
 - WO_STATUS_SCHEDULED: Scheduled on the machine timeline.
 - WO_STATUS_CHANGEOVER: Machine in changeover before this WO.
 - WO_STATUS_RUNNING: Production running.
 - WO_STATUS_COMPLETED: Production complete.
 - WO_STATUS_CLOSED: Closed (final qty locked).
 - WO_STATUS_REJECTED: Rejected back to PPC.
 - WO_STATUS_PC_APPROVED: PC approved (PC values confirmed); awaiting PM (sequential, v1.2).
 - WO_STATUS_CANCELLED: Cancelled/revoked with a reason (v1.2).

v1WasteCategoryMaster.description: WasteCategoryMaster is a per-area configurable waste / downgrade category.

v1WasteEntry.description: WasteEntry is one waste line in a shift submission.

lotNo.description:
PPC-generated lot number, UNIQUE — the lot source bobbin tracking must use
so production ETL joins back to the WO by lot.

crhHeadId.description: Route snapshot (cost_route_head; WO locks the version at generate/approve).

demandId.title: originating demand (customer/grade req flow from here)

refWoId.description:
WO Reference (duplicate / continuation).

referenced prior WO (0 = none)

gradeRequirement.description: Grade requirement (default from demand; WO may override).

specSnapshot.description:
Snapshots taken at approve (JSONB <-> Struct). spec = den/fil/type/ply/
shade/twist; packing = box/paper-tube/package-weight/pallet.

revisionReason.title: shown on the WO face (e.g. "PINDAH MC 05")

autoApproveDisabled.description:
When true the 24h auto-approve is disabled — WO will not run without an
explicit PM approval.

parameters.description: Children.

linkedPlanItems.description:
Every plan item this WO covers, including the anchor (plan_item_id above).
A merged WO carries more than one; each row holds its qty contribution.

v1WorkOrder.description: WorkOrder is the Layer-3 aggregate root (v1.2).

remainingQty.description:
Qty not yet produced: QtyTarget − SUM(production actual, actual first then
bobbin per row). Non-positive means fully produced — ineligible with reason.

machineLabel.description: Human label for the machine this WO runs on.

productLabel.description: Human label for the product this WO produces.

ineligibilityReason.description: Ineligibility reason, empty when the WO is eligible to carry.

alreadyCarried.description:
True when a WO in the target month already names this one as its carry
source — a second run over the same source shows it as done.

v1WorkOrderCarryCandidate.description:
WorkOrderCarryCandidate is one WO that may be carried into a new month,
decorated with everything the planner needs to decide without seeing an id.
